Swasthya Sathi AI - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Swasthya Sathi AI?
Swasthya Sathi AI is the Government of Odisha's official digital health gateway and advanced AI-powered health assistant. It is designed to provide citizens with instant, verified medical triage, disease symptom checking, nearby hospital discovery, and information regarding government health schemes like BSKY (Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana). It supports Odia, Hindi, and English.

How can Swasthya Sathi AI help me?
Swasthya Sathi AI can help you by:
1. Providing preliminary medical advice and symptom checking based on verified Odisha Health guidelines.
2. Finding the nearest verified government and private hospitals using your location.
3. Checking your eligibility and status for health schemes like BSKY.
4. Supplying emergency first aid instructions and helpline numbers (like 108 Ambulance and 104 Odisha Health).

Is the medical advice provided by Swasthya Sathi AI safe to follow?
Swasthya Sathi AI relies on verified data from the Directorate of Public Health & Family Welfare, Government of Odisha, and WHO guidelines. However, it is an AI assistant meant for preliminary triage and information. It does NOT replace a professional doctor. In case of severe symptoms or emergencies, always consult a qualified medical professional or call 108.

What is BSKY and who is eligible?
BSKY stands for Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana. It is a universal health coverage scheme by the Government of Odisha aimed at providing cashless healthcare to economically vulnerable families. Eligible families receive a Smart Health Card that provides coverage of up to Rs. 5 Lakhs per family per annum (and Rs. 10 Lakhs for women) at empanelled government and private hospitals.

How do I find the nearest hospital?
You can navigate to the "Find Hospitals" section in the app. The system will ask for your location permission. Once granted, it will display a map and a list of the closest verified hospitals, including District Headquarters Hospitals (DHH), Community Health Centres (CHC), and private empanelled hospitals, sorted by distance.

Can I use voice commands to chat with the AI?
Yes! Swasthya Sathi AI features a Voice Diagnosis mode. You can speak directly to the AI in Odia, Hindi, or English by clicking the microphone icon, and it will respond intelligently to your queries.

What should I do in an emergency?
If you are facing a medical emergency, do not wait for AI advice. Immediately call the 108 Ambulance service or the 104 Odisha Health Helpline. You can find these quick-dial buttons in the "Emergency Helplines" panel on the right side of the application.
